steps.note: Start creating the RFQ under test.
Enable the tenant feature that should mask RFQ commercials.

Use an RFQ-only event so the commercial masking behavior is isolated.
Add a commercial line item for the bid.
Commit a bidding window so the RFQ can be published and closed.

Publish the RFQ under the configured masking and opening settings.
Confirm the RFQ reached a real published project page.
Submit a vendor commercial response to create masked commercial data.
Confirm the vendor bid was accepted.
Close the RFQ so the configured opening behavior can take effect.
